motion.name: hover-spring
motion.purpose: Independent shard lift and local tilt.

interaction.print: Canvas UVs and projective semantic DOM overlays share one content source. UV hit testing activates the real anchor on a lifted shard.
interaction.reveal: Meet ShelfWise opens the project reveal; Back or Escape returns and restores focus. The no-script anchor opens About.
interaction.tutorial: Five tabs use roving tabindex, aria-selected, wrapping arrow keys, Home/End, panel labels, and polite live updates. Complete ordered instructions remain in HTML.
interaction.fallback: Initial reduced motion skips WebGL. Setup failure, context loss, or enabling reduced motion restores styled HTML. Reading pages and full text instructions work without scripts.

assets.team: User-supplied photograph; CSS portraits use that same image. Confirmed left-to-right order: Will Black, Conner Francis, Bradley Lund, Yi Yang.
assets.screenshots: Four actual guest-workflow screenshots captured from the supplied ShelfWise deployment on 2026-11-15.
assets.placeholders: Degree/program and contact/LinkedIn remain explicitly unfinished at the user request.

narrative.overview: ShelfWise adapts the existing smoked-glass template into a capstone project presence. Near-black ground, pale Inter typography, quiet spectral reflections, and restrained green accents connect the opening to the dark editorial pages. The opening keeps its moving cut network, independent shard hover, and reversible shatter; long-form content uses normal document flow.
keyCharacteristics: Live beveled glass on the opening, with selectable semantic text.
Readable editorial layouts for project details, biographies, and instructions.
Actual product screenshots and the supplied team photograph.
Clear keyboard focus, reduced-motion fallback, and complete text content.

rules.name: The Printed Ink Rule
rules.body: Keep canvas lettering and semantic HTML synchronized, including hover and focus feedback.

dos: Do preserve the live opening and its synchronized semantic controls.
Do keep long text in readable, scrolling editorial layouts.
Do use actual screenshots and the supplied photograph with asset provenance.
Do preserve explicit degree and contact placeholders until teammates supply details.
Do retain full text instructions, keyboard tabs, and reduced-motion/static access.
donts: Don't substitute invented product screenshots or inferred personal details.
Don't imply that planned project features were verified in the live application.
Don't add download requirements to the linked browser workflow.
